claims.statement: For an absent pair in a connected positive weighted loopless undirected graph, total conductance times effective resistance is at least4; equality is exactly a weighted K_(2,n-2) with each two-edge branch having equal weights.
claims.method: Dirichlet trial potential and harmonic equality

claims.statement: Each fixed-edge strength objective and its maximum of two positive-normalized endpoint objectives are strictly convex; each edge has one attained optimal strength on[0,infinity).

Continuum endpoint reduction and finite candidate characterization extend to every fixed connected positive weighted graph n>=3 under a fixed iid uniform-hub mixture interval below1 and a finite nonempty missing-edge set.

limitations: No variable topology oracle beyond the specified single-edge action family.
